alerts.label: Pay RBA Sep/Nov
alerts.rationale: Pay the RBA Sep/Nov meeting spread at 10bp. Legs are WIRP post-meeting OIS forwards (AU0BFR {MMM}{YYYY}), not the IB futures proxy. House convention: spread = later - earlier, pay = pay the back leg (Nov) / rec the front (Sep), so the position earns as the spread WIDENS. Enter once hike pricing between the two meetings compresses to 10bp (was +12.4bp on 16-Sep-26, i.e. Sep meeting +19bp then Nov +12bp on top). NOTE: there is no Oct-26 RBA meeting (AU0BFR OCT2026 is empty), and this spread dies with the ~29/30-Sep meeting - roll to NOV/DEC after it passes.
